verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a documented Lambda Cloud API, with an OpenAPI spec served keylessly, for creating and managing resources. It also shows a public pricing marketing page. Nothing documents an endpoint that returns the GPU or instance-type catalog with live pricing and current availability, so neither the API nor the static pricing page shows that an agent can query live price and capacity before spending.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can query the GPU catalog with live pricing and availability from a public or documented endpoint before committing any spend
